detections.evidence_quote: if you're 350, 400 pounds, and you want to lose weight, you have to shock your system by doing extreme things
detections.summary: Hosts use a weight-loss analogy: a very overweight person who wants to lose weight must go to extreme dietary lengths, eliminating all junk food, before later returning to a more normal eating pattern.

verification_candidates.claim_text: A person who is 350 to 400 pounds and wants to lose weight has to shock their system by doing extreme things.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: if you're 350, 400 pounds, and you want to lose weight, you have to shock your system by doing extreme things
verification_candidates.rationale: This asserts that extreme measures are necessary for weight loss at high body weight, which evidence on weight-loss methods could support or contradict.
